I was disappointed by the lack of price transparency at this clinic!

The price list at the clinic clearly shows that a dental post costs 3,500 Baht, with no indication that the price may vary. However, after the procedure today, I was charged 5,000 Baht.

When I asked about the difference, the staff explained that the price can range from 3,500 to 5,000 Baht depending on the condition of the tooth. The issue is that this range is not mentioned anywhere on their price list, which can be misleading for patients.

I also only had a dental post done and did not receive a crown, so the explanation referring to “post and crown” pricing was confusing.

Super happy with my experience! ✨
The cleaning and whitening were done perfectly — my teeth look amazing and feel completely natural. No sensitivity at all, which was super important for me.

Everything was smooth, professional, and honestly exceeded my expectations. 👌
Highly recommended if you want a bright smile without discomfort!

I've never had basic cleaning this quickly before.  I'm not sure if that's a good thing or not.  Lol.  But what do I know.  I was asked if I wanted to do more work on my teeth and I told the doctor that I only wanted the basic cleaning. She wasn't very personable or anything but not like it matters.  They cover your face and go straight to work.  Clean facility, prompt appointment, good English, no problems.  5 stars.

Scheduled an appoint at “HiSmile” thinking it was this location. Turns out that location is a different dental clinic with a very similar name. Since I was here anyway, I asked if they could see me and I was in luck as they had availability.

My dentist (I forget her name but a younger woman) was very polite and patient and walked me through different spots in my teeth. I’ve never had a dentist take the time to explain things as thoroughly before so I really appreciated that.

Overall I had a great experience at this clinic. I am someone who fears going to the dentist so the environment made me feel at more ease.

I visited for urgent dental treatment. The clinic changed my dentist last minute (different from the one who previously examined me) and communication was unclear.

The dentist was visibly angry and behaved in an aggressive, hostile manner. As a patient, I felt unsafe and had to leave without treatment.

Front desk staff were polite, but the clinical experience was unacceptable and unprofessional.

I’m open to updating this review if the clinic resolves the issue by arranging my appointment with the original consulting dentist and ensuring professional communication.

I had the Airflow Dental Spa deep cleaning treatment, and I honestly feel like my teeth have never been this clean before. I was a bit worried about pain, but the doctor kindly applied a numbing agent at my request before starting. I have a lot of stains on my teeth and I am very pleased the results. The price is reasonable—I paid 1,990 baht—and the quality of care was excellent. I would highly recommend this treatment.
I was very happy with the service at Hey Smile! I did a deep cleaning with Airflow and had two fillings. Dr. P was very efficient and did a great job!

The clinic helped me very quickly and with great professionalism. I had a small cavity in an old filling, and the doctor replaced it perfectly. The new filling looks so natural that you can’t even tell it’s there. It’s been two weeks now, and I haven’t had any problems at all.

I’m truly grateful for the prompt assistance and the high level of care.

I had my scaling and teeth whitening done at HeySmile Dental Clinic in Asoke during my short vacation in Thailand, and I’m so glad I chose them! The whole experience was great from start to finish. The staff were super friendly and made me feel comfortable right away.

The scaling was quick and surprisingly gentle—I didn’t feel any discomfort at all. And the whitening? The results speak for themselves. My teeth look so much brighter now, and I feel so much more confident about my smile.

What I really appreciated was how professional yet approachable the team was. They explained everything they were doing and made sure I was okay throughout the process.

If you’re thinking about getting teeth whitening or just need a good dentist, I’d definitely recommend HeySmile. They’ve got a great team, and I left feeling so happy with the results. 😊

The scaling and whitening treatment came to a total of 7190 THB. Half of what it would cost in my home country (Sweden).

Very bad clinic. I came for a simple procedure — teeth cleaning and fillings: I needed to treat two teeth with small cavities and replace an old filling. But the dentist said that fillings could only be done if I also agreed to root canal treatment, even though the damage was minimal. In other words, they tried to push me into unnecessary and expensive treatment just to take more money. I refused and agreed only to the cleaning.
They charged more than the price originally quoted, and the cleaning itself lasted barely 10 minutes and was done terribly: there was heavy bleeding, my teeth were left rough and dirty, and my lip was even injured. Afterward, my teeth did not feel smooth or fresh, as they should after a proper cleaning.
One more thing about the service: the clinic actually has a saliva suction device, but the dentist simply didn’t use it. Because of that, I had to keep stopping and spitting into the sink myself, which was extremely inconvenient.
